read_failed: The product could not be read: {error}
view_map_title: The product drawn: its parts and the links between them
view_gdl_title: The same product as the text Studio commits
look_subsystems_title: Each subsystem a column of cards saying what each part does
look_compact_title: Names only: the whole product at a glance
problems_more: and {count} more: the red and dashed nodes below.
menu_title: More: layers, fold all, unfold all
preview_built_title: Taken by a build of {commit} (version {version}) at {at}: the screen with an empty project, not real data
kids_unfold: Show the database each gear that keeps data gets
app_empty: No screens mounted: drag one here from the palette.
app_shared: shared, no screens of its own
no_layers: Every layer is hidden: turn one on above.
backend_empty: No gears yet: drag one here from the palette, or pick them under Backend.
infrastructure_empty: Shows once the product is checked: what the gears need running beside them.
group_unfold: Unfold: links to its nodes end here while it is folded
screens_hint: Drag onto Frontend, or Add. A screen mounts in the shell; the gears it calls show as links.
no_mfes: The catalogue has no micro-frontends: add one under Frontend.
gears_hint: Drag onto Backend, or Add. The engine then checks the product and says what else it needs.
catalogue_failed: The catalogue could not be read: {error}
nothing_more_matches: Nothing more to add that matches.
params_undescribed: The gear corpus does not describe its configuration: only what the product sets is shown.
detail_hint: Click a node to see what it is and what it links to, or a link to see where it comes from. Add screens and gears from the palette; the sections below the strip are the detailed views.
legend_missing: a gear a screen calls that the product lacks
legend_bad: stops a deploy: no database where it runs
pulled_in: The engine pulled it in: remove what needs it instead.
no_gears_to_compose: The product has no gears to compose.
gdl_composing: Composing the description the next save would write…
gdl_next_unresolved: What the next save writes (the engine does not resolve it yet).
gdl_differ: {count} line(s) differ from revision {revision}: + added, − removed.
gdl_kept: The kept revision {revision}: the product could not be composed ({note}).
gdl_none: No description yet, and the product could not be composed: {note}
gdl_click: Click a highlighted line to select it on the map.
infra_hint: Deployed with the product: each need of the gears is met by an infra service from the catalogue, its image imported into the project's path. Where it runs is the environment's setting.
infra_needs_later: The gears' needs show once the product is checked.
infra_no_offer: No infra service in the catalogue provides it.
infra_importing: Importing {image} into the project's path in {env}'s registry; use it once it is copied.
infra_no_copy: No copy of {image} is in the project's path yet: import it, then try again.
